stories.title: The first recorded grand slam in Women's Professional Baseball happened this week
stories.summary: Professional Women's Baseball is back - and this week the record books added the first Grand Slam -- thanks to the WPBL's Sarah Edwards from the Los Angeles Queens.

stories.title: Meditation, hunt-a-monk and two hours of silence: Welcome to Buddhist summer camp
stories.summary: At Dharma Camp is in the foothills of Oregon's Cascade Mountains, campers make friendship bracelets, play games and try to keep their fidgety bodies still enough to meditate. For some teens, summers camps can be an important time to explore their religious beliefs outside of home.

stories.title: The Senate voted to hold Dr. Fauci in contempt. Now what?
stories.summary: A Senate committee voted to hold Dr. Anthony Fauci in contempt after he refused to answer questions about his handling of the covid pandemic. Chairman Rand Paul plans to refer the case to the DOJ.

stories.title: Sources & Methods - Iran hacks the U.S.?
stories.summary: At least seven states experienced cyberattacks against their water systems recently, and the FBI is investigating whether they are linked with the war in Iran.

stories.title: Amid severe drought, Puerto Rico to begin rationing residents' water
stories.summary: Puerto Rico's government will begin rationing water on Friday as the island copes with its worst drought in more than a decade.

stories.title: Shia pilgrimage to Karbala includes millions of Iranians
stories.summary: Iranians are driven in greater numbers by the U.S. killing of their spiritual leader
